blocks.text: Pani par tairti tel ki patli tah (layer) ya sabun ke bulbule se roshni reflect ho (palat kar aaye) to aksar rangeen roshan patte nazar aate hain. Yeh interference ka nateeja hain. Aisi thin films (patli tahon) ki agli aur pichhli satah dono se roshni ki lehrein reflect hoti hain. In do reflected lehron ke raste ki lambai mukhtalif hai, aur in ka constructive interference mukhtalif wavelengths ke liye mukhtalif jagahon par hota hai. Fig. 15.11 yeh soorat dikhati hai. Motai (thickness) t wali thin film ki oopar wali satah par parne wali roshni ka kuch hissa oopar hi se reflect ho jata hai (rasta abc). Jo roshni oopar ki satah se andar chali jati hai (transmit hoti hai) us ka kuch hissa neeche wali satah se reflect hota hai (rasta abdef). Dono reflected lehrein aankh ke retina par point P par milti hain. Un ke phase ke talluq ke mutabiq constructive ya destructive interference ho sakta hai. Har rang ki wavelength alag hai, is liye kisi rang ke liye interference constructive aur kisi ke liye destructive ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Index n aur motai t ki patli tah (film) aik satah par, oopar hawa. Shua a film par b par pohanchti hai. Kuch hissa bc ke raste aankh ki taraf mun'akis; kuch film mein dakhil ho kar neeche ki satah d par mun'akis, e par oopar aa kar ef ke raste aankh ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.11: Patli tah (thin film) (kitab ki Figure 15.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Isi liye thin film mein rangeen naqshe nazar aate hain, jaise Fig. 15.12 (kitab mein tasveer) mein sabun ke mehlool (soap solution) ki patli tahein jo bulbule ki deewaren banati hain. Isi tarah pani par tairti tel ki patli tah bhi aisa hi naqsha dikhati hai. Rangeen naqshon ki pecheeda shaklein film ki motai mein farq ki wajah se banti hain.

Ab aik aasan soorat dekhein: monochromatic (aik hi rang/wavelength wali) roshni do taqreeban parallel satahon se taqreeban seedhi (normal incidence) par kar reflect hoti hai. Fig. 15.13 mein sheeshe ki do plates hain jin ke darmiyan hawa ki patli wedge (tikon numa tah) ya film hai. Hum hawa ki wedge ke saath wali do satahon se reflect hone wali do lehron ka interference dekhte hain. (Oopar wali plate ki oopar ki satah aur neeche wali plate ki neeche ki satah se bhi reflection hota hai, lekin baat saada rakhne ke liye unhein shamil nahi karte.) Soorat bilkul Fig. 15.11 jaisi hai, farq sirf yeh hai ke wedge ki motai har jagah barabar nahi. Har point par dono lehron ka path difference hawa ki wedge ki motai t ka dugna, yani 2t hai. Jahan 2t wavelength ka poora adad guna ho wahan constructive interference aur roshan hissa hona chahiye; jahan aadha-adad (half-integer) guna ho wahan destructive interference aur andhera hissa hona chahiye. Jahan plates aapas mein chhooti hain wahan path difference taqreeban sifar hai, is liye wahan roshan hissa hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 15.13(a)' likhti hai. Muqabla barabar motai wali thin film (Fig. 15.11) se hai; Fig. 15.13 ka koi hissa (a) nahi hai.

blocks.alt: Sheeshe ki do plates baen sire par chhooti hain; l faasle par h unchai ka spacer oopar wali plate ko utha kar hawa ka patla wedge banata hai. Contact se x faasle par hawa ki tah ki motai t hai. Wahan shua parti hai aur hawa ki tah ke oopar aur neeche se mun'akis do shuaein aankh tak jati hain. Labels: Air, Glass.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.13: Patli tah (hawa ka wedge) (kitab ki Figure 15.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Lekin tajurba karne par roshan aur andhere fringes to nazar aate hain, magar ulte! Jis lakeer par plates chhooti hain wahan andhera fringe milta hai, roshan nahi. Is se pata chalta hai ke dono reflected lehron mein se aik ne reflection ke waqt aadhe cycle (half cycle, 180°) ka phase shift liya hai. Is soorat mein contact wali lakeer par reflect hone wali dono lehrein, raste ki lambai barabar hone ke bawajood, aadha cycle out of phase hoti hain aur aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain.
Asal mein yeh phase shift Maxwell ki equations aur roshni ki electromagnetic fitrat se pehle hi bataya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Aadhe cycle ka phase shift tab hota hai jab roshni zyada refractive index wale medium se reflect ho. Hawa ki wedge mein yeh neeche wali sheeshe ki satah (hawa se sheesha) par hota hai, is liye contact ki lakeer andheri hai.

blocks.prompt: Interference ke rang sabun ke bulbule par kyun nazar aate hain lekin khirki ke sheeshe par kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Sabun ki tah sirf roshni ki chand wavelengths jitni moti hai, is liye dono reflections ka chhota path difference har rang ke liye alag nateeja deta hai. Khirki ka sheesha hazaron wavelengths mota hai; path difference bohat bara hai aur motai ya angle ke zara farq se rang badal kar aapas mein mil jate hain, is liye koi rang nazar nahi aata.

items: Thin film: oopar aur neeche ki satah se reflect hone wali lehrein interference karti hain; rang film ki motai par munhasir.
Hawa ki wedge: path difference 2t; 2t poori wavelengths = roshan, aadhi = andhera (agar phase shift na ho).
Tajurbe mein contact ki lakeer andheri: aik reflection par aadhe cycle ka phase shift.
